# Plugin.Avalonia.MVVMExpress

Independent Avalonia MVVM framework. Not a MAUI package.

- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Avalonia.MVVMExpress.Core
- GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Avalonia.MVVMExpress
- Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-avalonia-mvvmexpress/
- Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Avalonia.MVVMExpress`
- Register: `builder.Services.UseAvaloniaMvvmExpress(o => o.UseFrameNavigation(...).UseDialogs())`
- Version: 0.1.0-preview
- TFMs: net10.0 (Core) and net10.0 (host)
- Template: `dotnet new install Plugin.Avalonia.MVVMExpress.Templates` then `dotnet new avalonia-mvvmexpress`

Do not use when the app is MAUI (use Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress) or when CommunityToolkit.Mvvm properties/commands are enough.
